tasks.description: The task configurations. Usually these are enrichments of task already defined in the external task runner.

defaultSnippets.label: Shell task
defaultSnippets.description: A command line run in the shell.

defaultSnippets.label: Process task
defaultSnippets.description: A program run directly, with arguments.

taskCommand.description: The command to be executed. Can be an external program or a shell command.

cwd.description: The current working directory of the executed program or script. If omitted Code's current workspace root is used.

env.description: The environment of the executed program or shell. If omitted the parent process' environment is used.

enumDescriptions: The command is run in a shell.
The command is run as a program, with its arguments.
A Cargo subcommand (`command`), with its arguments.
type.description: Defines whether the task is run as a process or as a command inside a shell.

args.description: Arguments passed to the command when this task is invoked.

enumDescriptions: Marks the task as a build task accessible through the 'Run Build Task' command.
Marks the task as a test task accessible through the 'Run Test Task' command.
Assigns the task to no group

isDefault.description: Defines if this task is the default task in the group.

group.description: Defines to which execution group this task belongs to. It supports "build" to add it to the build group and "test" to add it to the test group.
